title: Contract redline decision latency reducer & auto-counterproposal hub
creator: Arielle Chen
description:
Problem: Sales and Legal report that MSA/DPA redline turnaround exceeds target SLA (median decision latency ~7 business days) for mid-market deals. This delays quoting, increases churn risk for high-touch prospects, and inflates legal review costs. Current triage is manual: sales attaches redlines to tickets, Legal routes to specialists, drafts counterproposals, and PRs are manually tracked in Drive/Confluence. We need a product-led intervention to reduce human touch where safe, surface high-risk edits faster, and auto-generate first-draft counterproposals for low-risk redlines so Sales can continue conversations while Legal focuses on true exceptions.

Proposed solution (scoped MVP):
- Build a redline classification service that tags incoming MSA/DPA edits into risk bands (Acceptable/Negotiable/HighRisk) using a ruleset + ML scoring (seeded from historical redline decisions).
- Implement a decision-latency dashboard for Legal/Sales showing per-deal latency, queue depth, and estimated decision time; expose top two root causes for delays per ticket.
- Auto-counterproposal hub: For edits classified Negotiable, automatically draft a counterproposal template that Legal can approve with one-click or send to Sales as a pre-approved fallback. Include estimated pricing impact and indemnity exposure notes.
- Integrations: wire into Contract Intake form (Sales) + Legal ticketing; store artifacts in Drive and annotate PRs with classification results.

Out of scope for MVP: full automated approval for HighRisk items, complex liability re-engineering, entitlement or billing system changes.

Success metrics (30/60/90 days):
- Median redline decision latency reduced from 7 to <=3 business days (target within 60d).
- >=40% of Negotiable edits receive an auto-draft counterproposal; Legal one-click acceptance rate >=50%.
- Sales-reported time-to-quote improved by 2 business days on average for experimental cohort.

Acceptance criteria:
- Classification service runs on new intake and historical backlog (batch), returns risk band + confidence score.
- Dashboard shows latency KPIs and can filter by customer tier, region, and issue type.
- Auto-draft counterproposal generator produces a sanitized, template-backed patch and links to the ticket + estimated pricing delta.
- Legal sign-off workflow exists (approve/reject/edit) and changes update the ticket status and Drive artifact.

Risks & mitigations:
- Incorrect classification could surface bad counterproposals: include manual approval gate and conservative thresholds for auto-drafting.
- Data sensitivity: ensure drafts are stored in restricted Drive folders and audit-logged. See security review required.
- Sales adoption: run a pilot with two AE teams and enable feedback loop for model/rules tuning.

Rollout plan:
1) Proof-of-concept run on 200 backlog tickets (Feb)
2) Pilot with 2 AE pods + Legal specialist queue (Mar)
3) Full team launch with training + runbook (Apr)
